Scaling Climate Action with EU support

GGF has taken a major step forward in its mission to scale climate action across Southeast Europe.

 

The European Union’s €24 million investment gives us greater capacity to mobilize public and private capital to support the green transition.

 

This backing comes at a critical moment.  

 

Across the region, the pressure on energy systems is growing and the need for climate investment is becoming increasingly urgent.  

 

GGF’s role is to provide financing that can reach real projects and support long-term sustainable growth.

Delivering for investors

We provide diversification with risk-mitigation

Investing in EU Accession and Neighbourhood regions can deliver diversification and long-term returns.


But some investors perceive the risk to be high.

 

We give you access to these investments with first- and second-loss protection.  

Enhance your portfolio Learn about the fund manager

Delivering for the planet

We finance renewable energy as well as energy efficiency and resource efficiency projects across a variety of sectors, including agriculture, transport and corporates.

These projects generate sustainable economic growth, reduce energy dependence, stabilize supply chains and mitigate climate change.  

 

We finance high-impact activities across the EU Neighbourhood region, often through our close relationships with local financial institutions.

 

Our specialists live and work where they invest - they know their sector, market and assets intimately. Our advisory & capacity building teams also broaden and deepen your impact. They tailor education and consultancy services for investees, and contribute to market development. 

Deepen your impact For investees

Where we invest

We live and work where our assets are based. With 9 regional offices and over 15 years of experience, we know how to navigate shifting market dynamics.

“Green for Growth Fund gives you access to diversified, impact-driven projects through trusted local institutions you can’t reach via traditional channels. These diversified investments are future-focused and built on long-term EU-aligned growth drivers.” 

 

Learn more

Borislov Kostadinov, Fund Director

Information for potential investors

In respect of the United States of America, Canada, Japan or Australia or any other jurisdiction in which the distribution, offer, sale, transfer or resale would be prohibited by applicable law, no investment in notes/shares or other instruments of the Fund (or its sub-fund(s)) can be offered or made.
